integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by a complete face-poset enumeration and an explicitly verified acyclic discrete-Morse matching; finite computation is used only for this finite instance.
scientific_limitations: Finite instance only: ordinary 5-cut complex of the 3x3 grid.
No shellability or all-n theorem is claimed.
title: The \(5\)-cut complex of the \(3\times3\) grid is a wedge of \(25\) three-spheres
